meta.title: About · Mateos
meta.description: Mateos builds MateOS, the operating layer for owner-led companies. Six people on the machine, three advisors who shaped the thesis.

hero.lead: We walk into the room that runs an owner-led company, find where the time goes, and give it back.
hero.micro: Founded in 2026. Israel, with operations in New York.

title: Israel built the tech the world runs on.
Now its industry should lead with it.
mission.lead: Israel’s start-ups changed how the world works. Its factories, insurers, builders and distributors, the backbone of the economy, still run on paper, phone calls and memory.
mission.goal: We’re here to put Israeli industry and non-technical companies at the forefront of how companies everywhere work.
mission.built: Built in Hebrew, on the systems owners already run.

people.name: Yair Nativ
people.bio: Third-time founder. Built Safe Lane, a national road-safety program with 100,000 volunteers. Founded Voiceable, backed by Nielsen.

people.name: David Rajcher
people.bio: 20 years building systems, in the Intelligence Corps and as a founding engineer. Founded Webeet, an AI agency. A developer who speaks human.

people.name: Aviv Yogev
people.bio: Puts us in the room with the CEO. Closes in two weeks what takes others months.

people.name: Shayna Moliver
people.bio: MIT master’s in supply chain management. Four years as an embedded chief of staff to growing companies. Runs operations, deal flow and unit economics from New York.

people.name: Matan Zigron
people.bio: Founder and CEO of Wito since 2020. Before that, VP Clients and head of digital at zeder:yariv advertising. Owns the message and the November launch.

people.name: Almog Cohen
people.bio: Was the Co-Founder and CTO of VIVID, an AI personal-growth platform he grew to 35,000 daily users. Led R&D teams at Testim.io and Sears.

advisors.title: Three advisors who shaped the thesis.
advisors.lead: Each one works a specific part of the machine, not the brand.

people.name: Michael Schrage
people.role: Research fellow, MIT Sloan. Author of The Innovator's Hypothesis.
people.on: the learning loop. Results are the KPI. The client and the model both learn from them.

people.name: Noam Mantel
people.on: the path from custom builds to one product.

people.name: Nir Eisikovits
people.role: Professor of AI ethics. Director of the Applied Ethics Center, UMass Boston.
people.on: the control layer. A person wherever it’s needed. Red lines before code.

items.p: Not with a tool. The goal comes first, and the flows are built back from it.
Mate proposes, a person approves. And there is always a person you can call.
An estimate is labeled an estimate. A potential found is not a saving delivered.
Part of our fee rides on the number you already watch. Not hours, not seats.

join.title: Want to build this with us?

title: It’s your company.
Your move.
start.lead: Start with an X-ray. One day on site, every process ranked by payback. From $990.
